kpis.description_fr: Distribution pièces auto aftermarket (NAPA Auto Parts). Plus grand segment GPC, base parc vieillissant aux US.
kpis.description_en: Automotive aftermarket parts distribution (NAPA Auto Parts). Largest GPC segment, aging US car parc base.

kpis.description_en: Motion Industries: industrial parts distribution (bearings, hydraulics, automation) US/Canada/Australia.

kpis.description_fr: Magasins NAPA Auto Parts (US + International). Mix franchisés/intégrés, densité réseau = avantage logistique.
kpis.description_en: NAPA Auto Parts stores (US + International). Mix franchised/company-owned, network density = logistics edge.
